meta.name: Meet Me After School
meta.description:
Emotions resurface when a school teacher and her former student reconnect three years after sharing a forbidden attraction that scarred them both.

Ended · First aired 9 Oct 2018 · Japan · Language: Japanese · 56 min
Studio: TBS, Dreamax Television · Network: TBS

Complete series. On your server: S1 11/11

On your server — Audio: Japanese (from file names)

videos.title: Teacher and Student... A Love Story About a Forbidden Pure Love
videos.overview: Hijiri Suenaga begins teaching at a rural middle school, but her enthusiasm goes to waste. One of her students, Akira, gets involved in an incident.

videos.title: Unstoppable Awakening of Love... The Opening Act of the Disturbance at the Athletic Festival
videos.overview: Hijiri brushes off Akira's confession of love. She begins avoiding him, but he takes a bold action during the school's sports festival.

videos.title: Feelings Finally Overwhelm at the Intimate Study Sleepover!
videos.overview: The Koboshi students and faculty embark on a four-day study camp, but Akira gets into a fight with a classmate. Hijiri asks him what happened.

videos.title: A Sudden Breakthrough! On the Night of the Firework Festival, the Gears of Fate Begin to Turn!
videos.overview: A night of turmoil begins at a local fireworks festival, where Hijiri sees Akira and Runa together. Shotaro and Haraguchi visit as well.

videos.title: A Failure as a Teacher! The Repercussions of a Forbidden Love... What Will Be Her Decision?!
videos.overview: After their kiss on the beach, Akira and Hijiri run into Akira’s mother and Shotaro outside Hijiri's place. Shioya summons Hijiri to the school.

videos.title: Three Years Later... A Love That Begins in a New Life... Unforgettable Emotions...
videos.overview: Three years later, Hijiri is teaching at the elementary school where Chizuru works. One day, she is shaken when she sees Akira at a local bazaar.

videos.title: Suddenly, the Past Is Exposed?! Each and Every Painful Emotion...
videos.overview: Moved by Nogami's kindness, Hijiri tries to move on. She confronts a mother about her parenting, but the mother threatens to reveal Hijiri's secret.

videos.title: Goodbye, Ms. Suenaga... Putting Their Lives on Elopement! The Fated Decision and Confession
videos.overview: While Hijiri and Nogami prepare for the upcoming school recital, the parents learn about Hijiri's incident with Akira from three years prior.

videos.title: The First Night With Just the Two of Us... I Won't Let You Go Anymore!
videos.overview: Hijiri accompanies Akira on his journey to find his father. As they spend more time together, Akira’s feelings toward Hijiri are reignited.

videos.title: Their Mutual Feelings Are a Sin...?! The Moms Stand in the Way
videos.overview: Upon returning to Tokyo, Hijiri is met by her mother, who tears her away from Akira. The next day, Hijiri and her mother visit Aiko to apologize.

videos.title: Thrusted With the Ultimate Choice! The Two Finally Choose Their Future
videos.overview: After being apprehended by the police, Hijiri loses everything. With her feelings toward Akira growing in her heart, she must make a crucial decision.
